steps.u: We changed how deploys work (blue green instead of rolling). Update the runbook so on-call knows how to roll back.

steps.r: Deploys roll one pod at a time. To roll back run `helm rollback`.
Two identical environments; traffic switched at the load balancer; the old environment stays warm for 30 minutes.

steps.a: Rollback is now a traffic switch back to the warm environment, not a helm rollback, and it only works for 30 minutes; after that the old environment is gone and a redeploy of the previous version is needed. The runbook must say both.

i.content: Blue green deploy. Rollback within 30 minutes: switch traffic back at the load balancer. After 30 minutes: redeploy the previous version. Check the health dashboard after switching.

reference.summary: Rewrote the deploy runbook for the move from rolling to blue green deployments: rollback is now a traffic switch to the warm environment within 30 minutes, with a redeploy of the previous version after that.

decisions.choice: document the 30 minute window and the redeploy fallback
decisions.reason: the warm environment disappears after 30 minutes so a switch back no longer works
